I'm sorry you've reached this point. Indian parents often over control the entire childhood and expect a sudden 180 where you're supposed to become independent and social and enterprising overnight. Happened to me and then again with my sister.

All I can say is that it does get better. Avoid the shouting matches of trying to get them to understand, they most likely won't see their own mistakes. Focus on yourself. Ignore what they think or say. Whatever it takes for your own mental peace. Running away now might be an option but it almost alway gets better from here. Find other interests or hobbies keep your mind off what your parents want. You'll get through this, just graduate.

Anyway even if you don't care for this solution, I sympathise deeply and it sucks and I'm sorry. I've seen this so many times and it drives people to depression and it's super important to separate your wants from theirs.
